_note: Offline fixtures for bin/templates.js --smoke. Uses repo media only, so it needs no keys and no network. The copy here is deliberately near the length limits, because a fixture with three-word headlines proves nothing about a template that has to hold a real one.

editorial-card.subhead: The listing photo they linger on is almost never the kitchen. It is the room they can picture living in.

cards.caption: Light, plain, and easy to imagine your own things in
For the move-up buyer who wants to be sold to

style-grid.subhead: Same photograph, four presets, four people who each think it was staged for them.

stat-card.claim: That is the whole job now.
stat-card.support: Physical staging takes a week to book, a day to install, and comes back out before closing.
stat-card.source: Measured on Stagify renders, not a market estimate.

slider-hero.caption: Drag the line on any listing photo

pairs.myth: Virtual staging is basically lying to buyers.
pairs.mythNote: The objection most agents raise first, and the one competitors avoid answering.
pairs.fact: It is legal, expected, and labelled.
pairs.factNote: MLS and NAR rules ask for disclosure, not abstinence. Every Stagify render carries the tag automatically.

pairs.myth: Buyers feel cheated when they walk in.
pairs.fact: They feel cheated when nobody told them.
pairs.factNote: A labelled render sets the expectation. An unlabelled one is the thing that breaks trust.

callouts.text: Seating pulled off the wall so the room reads deeper than it is
Art hung at eye height, which is where a buyer's camera phone lands
A rug sized to the sofa, the single most common staging mistake

quote-card.quote: I stopped booking the staging company for anything under four hundred thousand. This does the photos in an afternoon.

steps.title: Upload the listing photo
steps.note: Straight off the camera roll. No measuring, no floor plan.

steps.title: Download it labelled

proofs.line: An empty room gives a buyer nothing to hold onto.
proofs.note: They cannot judge scale, so they judge the photo instead.
A sofa in frame is the cheapest way to answer the only question they have.

proofs.line: And it costs nothing to try.
proofs.note: One photo, one preset, no card.

close.note: It is the photo doing the least work in your listing right now.
